## About

Eleven small patches to om-emu, the emulator by the om-emu contributors. They ship as git diff files with an apply script and om-emu's MIT notice. There is no fork. Four patches add drawing, such as the 32-bit layer the vector GPU draws into and a still picture under the overlays. Seven add optional checks that are off by default.

Each check was added after a real failure on a camera. It had to fail the broken image and pass both the fixed image and the stock firmware. Eight of the eleven patches are not tied to one camera body. The two that start the second and third processor cores carry E-M5 III addresses, and the kernel-check patch names one E-M5 III address.

As the project describes them. Status is the project's own; linked evidence is the Atlas's record of what was reported or observed.

<div class="feature-grid" markdown="1">

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Screen drawing** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

GPU picture layer, live-view stand-in picture, bitmaps without a colour table, display register write log.

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Start-up and memory checks** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

Section first-touch monitor, cache model, heap fill, and a monitor that fails any write into always-loaded code.

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Kernel and bus checks** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

Blocking calls made from interrupt context, and a serial bus tap that fails a message with no device address.

</div>

<div class="feature-card" markdown="1">

**Second and third processor cores** <span class="pill pill-released">Available</span>
{ .feature-head }

Starts CPU 1 and CPU 2 natively beside the main core.

## Research notes

Plain patch files for a fixed om-emu commit. Offered here until om-emu takes them upstream. Tested on E-M5 III 1.7, and briefly on OM-5 1.2 and OM-5 II 1.1 block 0.
